mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 2% annualized coincides with higher corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 > 2% YoY for 3 months, 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from flat (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing earnings growth and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.5% for 3 months, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 0.5% signals weakening manufacturing activity, lowering earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 0.5% YoY for 3 months, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 2.5% for 3 months, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below -1% annualized signals weakening demand, reducing earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 < -1% YoY for 3 months, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 0.5% signals improving labor market conditions, boosting earnings expectations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 0.5% YoY for 3 months, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 2% signals strengthening manufacturing activity, raising earnings expectations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 2% YoY for 3 months, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.10).
